messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Spike in 5xx (502/504) and 429s observed for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings across eu-west-1 and us-central-1. Spike start ~1901256400. Paging oncall.
oncall-kim: acked. joining. any known changes in infra or quota configs?
raj: looking at quota service metrics — there's a sudden jump in enforcement events around 1901256300. Gateway p95 latency up to 900ms, and several upstream 502s.
mike: no app deploys in last 4h. infra autoscaler triggered scale-out for model-pools an hour ago. deploy-bot confirms no recent infra code pushes.
lina-cs: CS reports multiple customers seeing timeouts and 429s. One customer opened an incident saying "requests blocked by quota".
kevin-eng: scanning config commits — there was a policy promotion of `global-throttle-v1` at 1901256200. The diff includes a wildcard route assignment for '/v1/*' with a low global limit.
oncall-kim: that looks like the smoking gun. If propagation was partial, some frontends would enforce it and others would not, causing uneven 429s and upstream overload -> 5xx. Mitigation steps: (A) revert policy, (B) relax enforcement, (C) enable gateway soft-fail for quota timeouts, (D) scale quota-service replicas.
raj: grabbing quota-service controller logs now. snippet:
```
ERROR quota-controller.go:211: applyPolicy: invalid policy assignment: wildcard route applied to global bucket
WARN propagation.go:92: propagation took 56s for region eu-west-1
```
kevin-eng: initiating rollback to `policy-2024-09-stable` now.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by kevin-eng at 1901256860. running rollout. canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
mike: while rollback is in flight, setting `quota_check_timeout=300ms` and `quota_timeout_behavior=allow` in api-gateway for eu-west-1 and us-central-1 to prevent hard failures on slow quota-checks.
oncall-kim: limit the soft-fail window, document change in the incident log. Raj, can you extract impacted org list for ops postmortem?
raj: extracting now. initial scan: ~22 orgs hit enforcement; top 4 orgs make up ~68% of blocked traffic. will redact IDs here and push to secure ticket.
kevin-eng: rollback completed at 1901257025. propagation looks healthy now.
incident-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE. Expect metric improvement within ~90s.
oncall-kim: dashboards show 1m error rate dropping from 20% -> 6% within 2m. 5xxs reduced but some lingering spikes. continuing to monitor.
lina-cs: CS: started templated outreach to affected customers. collecting confirmation responses.
ops-manager: need list and SLA exposure assessment. please include exact time windows and counts.
raj: compiled CSV of impacted orgs and counts, uploaded to secure ticket INF-5242. will attach logs.
kevin-eng: implementing infra hardening: (1) add validation to prevent wildcard assignment at global scope, (2) require canary propagation checks in policy rollout pipeline, (3) default quota-check circuit-breaker to soft-fail after 200ms, (4) autoscale quota-service based on enforcement rate. Creating follow-up tasks INF-5243-INF-5246.
mike: increased quota-service replicas +2 in eu-west-1 at 1901257240 to reduce propagation latency.
oncall-kim: set handoff: I'm offline for 30m. Raj, you're lead. keep slack updates every 15m. escalate if error rate > 5%.
raj: copy. stand-in cadence set. setting calendar reminder for follow-up sync at 1901258600.
kevin-eng: note — temporarily exempted enterprise API keys from global policy so critical customers not impacted. change applied 1901257345.
lina-cs: enterprise customer A confirmed service restored at 1901257500. they'll request RCA.
ops-manager: good mitigation. preserve all diffs, logs, and timestamps for postmortem. we'll want a runbook update to avoid noisy pages for propagation delays.
oncall-kim: agreed. also add automated rollback trigger: if post-rollout 5xx > 3% for 3m, auto-revert.
mike: creating ticket INF-5247 for automatic rollback threshold.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate stabilized ~1.0% for 15m. 429 events traced to misapplied global quota policy. Severity: Sev2 (pending final review).
raj: attaching sanitized timeline and proof of rollback to incident ticket. will synthesize impact numbers for the postmortem.
lina-cs: collecting customer confirmations and drafting communication. will coordinate with operations on timing.
oncall-kim: thanks all. leaving channel open. postmortem owners: kevin-eng, raj, lina-cs. ops-manager will schedule follow-up meeting.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 1901260389. root cause candidate: faulty quota policy rollout -> uneven enforcement (429) -> gateway/backends overloaded -> 5xx/timeouts. Follow-ups assigned.
